text: Evening. Got a room for one night?
Been walking since dawn. I'm done in.

label: Ask their name
text: Just call me a traveler. Names don't buy much out here.

label: Ask where they're headed
text: Somewhere the road stops. You know any place like that?
Yeah. Figured as much.
Fair enough. Lead the way.

label: Turn them away
text: No room? After all that walking?
I won't be trouble. Gone by first light.
...Fine. I've slept in worse than a ditch.
Thank you. You won't hear a sound from me.
What do you want at this hour?

label: Ask about the noise last night
text: Noise? I was asleep the whole time.
Ah - yes. Hello. A room. Please. Just the one.
Long day. Very long. You have no idea.

label: Ask about his suitcase
text: Samples! Brushes mostly. Nothing you'd want. Nothing at all.

label: Ask why he's shaking
text: Cold out. That's all. Just the cold.
I said it's the cold! Are we done here?

label: Turn them away
text: No? Please. I can pay double.
Where else is open? Nowhere. You know that.
This is a mistake. You'll see.
Fine. FINE. I'm going.
Oh thank you. You won't even know I'm here.
Same as always. Key. Now.
You're slow tonight. Move it.

label: Ask him to wait a moment
text: I don't wait. That's your job.

label: Ask for identification
text: You've seen my face a hundred times.
Here. Happy? Don't lose it this time.

label: Turn them away
text: Excuse me?
You do NOT turn me away. Not me.
You'll regret this. Count on it.
Finally.
A room. Away from the road if you have one.

label: Ask why away from the road
text: I sleep lighter than most.

label: Ask if she's travelling alone
text: Is that a requirement?
...Yes. Alone.
That's my business. Not yours.

label: Turn them away
text: I see.
I'll find somewhere. I always do.
Good. Don't knock after dark.
Evening evening! Cold one out there tonight isn't it?
Room for an old man's bones?

label: Ask about his journey
text: Oh it's a long story. Which part do you want?
It started forty years back in a town that isn't on the maps anymore...
Visiting family. Or what's left of them.

label: Ask about the weather
text: Storm's coming. Mark my words. Sky goes green first.

label: Ask if he needs anything
text: Kind of you to ask.
Bless you. These old knees will thank you.
I wouldn't say no to that.

label: Turn them away
text: Oh. Oh dear. On a night like this?
I don't move so fast anymore. Have a heart.
...Alright. Sorry to have troubled you.
Bless you son. Sleep well now.
